title: Joining Petit, Morgan, Kelly and Ory after the Army
summary: Punch came home from the Army and joined the leading bands; he learned Dogtown songs on the advertising wagon with Kid Ory.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah. And I saw, talking about Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Chris Keller, Kid René, and Jack Keller. I just wanted to see them fellas, them time with big shots.
Well, a little bit. And you were with them?

Yeah, I came here from the Army and got right in there with them. They heard me playing, and they just lashed right on to me. I was, I was, I'll come here, but I didn't know many songs, which was playing in civilian life then. I don't know, a lot of Army songs. So, yeah, I, I didn't take me no time to learn them, soon to play stuff. I learned, I know the first time I got on the wagon with Kid O'er to make an advertisement for a big dance. They just hired me because I played at the, uh, 25 with them one night when they knew everything. So, they hired me, and that's where I landed on the truck, Dogtown Shutters Bowl. Oh, yeah. I learned that on the wagon. They played it, and I said, you know, you know, and so they said, great. And I just knit right out on it. Played it. That's the truth.
Did you know it's a long way to temporary? Oh, yeah. When did you play that number? In the Army. Oh, yeah.
